name: Ultimate Nullification
oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a legendary creature.
Exile all creatures and graveyards. Put Ultimate Nullification on the bottom of its owner's library.
blocked_sentences: Put Ultimate Nullification on the bottom of its owner's library.

needs.what: a card-level rider (or a bottom form of tucks_itself) that, as the instant or sorcery resolves, puts the spell on the BOTTOM of its owner's library instead of into its graveyard
needs.why_existing_wont_do: tucks_itself is an ordinal counted from the top (Approach of the Second Sun's 'seventh from the top'), and _place_after_resolution converts it to an insert index from the top, so no value says 'bottom' of a library whose size varies; put_on_top has bottom: true but it moves objects during resolution, while the spell is still on the stack and is then unconditionally placed by _place_after_resolution, so pointing it at the spell itself is not a supported or gated path
